morphology.pattern_note: 这是完整词根，开头的 ker- 不是词缀；首音节 e 读 /ə/，末尾 au 为双元音 /au̯/。

word_family.gloss: 拥有或饲养水牛，见谚语用法
多头水牛；全词重叠形式

senses.zh_definition: 水牛；体型粗壮、有角的牛科动物，常供耕作、产乳或肉用。
senses.en_definition: A water buffalo, a large horned bovine commonly kept for draught work, milk or meat.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis haiwan ternakan daripada keluarga lembu yang bertubuh besar, bertanduk dan lazimnya berkulit kelabu atau kehitaman.
senses.nuances: 一般指水牛，现代学名为 Bubalus bubalis；输入中的 Bos bubalus 是旧式学名。与 lembu“牛”有别。某些谚语借水牛表达盲从等评价，但不能据此把“笨人”列为无语境限制的普通义。[DBP：kerbau](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=kerbau)

dual_scenarios.ms: Penternak diminta memastikan kerbau mereka mendapat bekalan air bersih yang mencukupi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 当局要求养殖户确保所饲养的水牛获得充足的清洁饮水。
dual_scenarios.en: Farmers were asked to ensure that their buffaloes had enough clean drinking water.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tengok tu, kerbau tengah berkubang kat tepi sawah!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Lihat itu, kerbau sedang berkubang di tepi sawah!
dual_scenarios.zh: 快看，水牛正在稻田边泡泥水呢！
dual_scenarios.en: Look, there's a buffalo wallowing beside the paddy field!
spoken_features: tengah 在此对应 sedang，表示动作进行中
kat 在此对应地点介词 di

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kat tepi sawah tu ada kerbau. Nak berhenti tengok kejap?
messages.ms_standard: Ada kerbau di tepi sawah itu. Mahukah kamu berhenti untuk melihatnya sebentar?
messages.zh: 那边稻田旁有水牛。要不要停一下看看？
messages.en: There's a buffalo beside that paddy field. Want to stop for a quick look?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak! Kita tengok dari sini je lah.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya mahu. Kita lihat dari sini sahaja.
messages.zh: 要啊！我们就在这儿看吧。
messages.en: Sure! Let's just watch from here.

etymology.historical_story: Kerbau belongs to a regional network of buffalo names. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary groups Malay kərbaw with forms such as Tagalog kalabáw and traces the borrowing history ultimately to a Mon-Khmer source. The word therefore preserves evidence of contact between mainland and island Southeast Asian languages, rather than a meaning assembled from modern Malay prefixes and roots. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/formsets/30106)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 ker.bau 的两拍配上画面：一头大水牛，慢慢走进泥水塘；au 连读成一个滑动的元音。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈动物时是中性词；用来称呼人，或以水牛比喻对方迟钝、盲从，容易构成侮辱。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于农业、乡村生活和动物观察。bagai kerbau dicucuk hidung 比喻任人摆布、盲目服从，带明显批评意味。[DBP：相关谚语](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=226380&keyword=kerbau)
